name: setting-row
title: Setting Row
description: One row of a settings page: a `title` and `description` at the start, the control that changes it in `actionSlot` at the end, dropping under the text when the row is too narrow for both. `actionSlot` may be a function handed the title's id, so a switch or select is named by the title through `aria-labelledby`. `descriptionPlacement="popover"` folds the description behind a button beside the title.
